items.value: Employer pays the first 33 days of sickness a year at 80% of pay (14 days for staff aged 50+); ZUS pays sickness benefit thereafter; sick pay carries no social contributions

items.basis: Fully-loaded hourly cost INCLUDES: gross total pay (Sedlak OBW "wynagrodzenie całkowite" = base + bonuses / variable pay, indexed to 2026 and adjusted to the four clusters), paid annual leave and public holidays (inside the 12 monthly salaries), sick pay at 80% for 10 days, the statutory night allowance on one third of hours worked (3 × 8 h, shop-floor roles), and employer ZUS + FP + FGŚP + PPK (21.98%); divided by 1,720 productive hours.

NOT included (not sourced): 13th-month salary (no statutory 13th month in Polish private industry — any annual bonus is already inside OBW total pay), shift allowances above the statutory night allowance, ZFŚS social fund write-off (mandatory at ≥50 FTE), bridging-pension FEP 1.5%, PFRON, meal / transport / work-clothing / medical exams, training time, overtime and weekend premiums, agency-worker margins, severance and jubilee-award accruals.
items.notes: Sedlak total pay is a mixed sample of single-shift and multi-shift workers, so part of the night allowance may already be inside it (possible overlap ≤ 3,293 PLN/yr = 1.9 PLN/h).

notes: Web fetch was blocked for every host in this session (stat.gov.pl, Eurostat, TGE, Tauron, wynagrodzenia.pl); all figures come from search-result extracts of the cited pages. 35 searches used.

Occupation wages are Sedlak & Sedlak OBW medians ("wynagrodzenie całkowite": total gross incl. variable pay); the pages print no survey year and are taken as OBW 2025, indexed to 2026 by the GUS enterprise-sector growth +5.6% y/y and moved to the four clusters by the GUS March 2026 voivodeship-median ratio 0.9838. GUS occupation tables (Oct 2024) were not reachable per occupation — only the ISCO major-group 8 mean/median (used as a cross-check).

Loaded rates (PLN/h): skilled 66.34, semiskilled 61.46, foundry 56.57, electronics 54.80, inspector 61.63, technician 72.71, supervisor 77.06, forge 59.97, furnace 56.57, blow/roto/thermoform 55.09, trimRouter 66.34, engineer (day) 85.02.
